newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Harvest hits spring bids.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Harvest hits spring bids.

text.p: Cash bids for dark northern spring wheat were down on Tuesday as the rapidly approaching harvest sent basis levels tumbling, several cash dealers said.
Meanwhile, hard red winter wheat harvest was progressing in Montana and several dealers reported seasonal railcar shortages as new crop wheat piled up.
"Montana needs trains desperately to go to the Gulf," one dealer said. "We're filling up."
Another Montana dealer said railcar shortages were common at this time of year because many cars were being used for the soft red winter wheat harvest in the U.S. Midwest.
The dealer added that farmer selling remained light and many were inquiring about storage rates.
